features.name: Accelerated requirements gathering with AI
features.description: Using AI tooling to draft requirement statements quickly with high accuracy and gain early insight into gaps from workshop notes and documentation, freeing up consultant time for higher value work.
caveats: Consultant remains fully responsible for accuracy
Not meant for final solution design yet, just early insight

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot for requirements extraction
features.description: Using Copilot in Excel and Microsoft 365 applications to extract and formalize requirements from workshop notes, identifying gaps, open questions, and creating structured requirement lists with business central mapping.
caveats: Requires access to workshop notes and templates
Works best with structured input data

features.name: AI-powered requirements analysis and gap detection
features.description: Using Copilot to analyze requirements for completeness, detect gaps and assumptions, check against business central functionality, and identify ambiguous or unanswered questions to support the consultant's work.
caveats: Can access Microsoft Learn and organizational documentation if ISV
Consultant validation remains essential

features.name: Power Platform for process mockups
features.description: Using Power Apps as a rapid prototyping tool to mock up new processes and user experience designs without intending to deliver the Power App, purely for systems design and user understanding.
caveats: Mentioned as a possibility, not demonstrated
Intended as a design aid, not final delivery

features.name: Requirements worksheet generation with Copilot
features.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot creates a structured worksheet with functional requirements, Business Central interpretations, source mappings, and open questions section to identify ambiguities in customer requirements.
caveats: User remains fully responsible for accuracy and actioning items
Requires proper linking to standard Business Central

features.name: Process simplification and requirement analysis
features.description: AI-driven prompts to summarize customer processes, identify inconsistencies in requirements, detect implicit or missing requirements, and spot gaps that are difficult to identify manually when reviewing large volumes of requirements entries.
caveats: Difficult to spot inconsistencies without AI assistance on large requirement sets
Requires user to define prompts and personas

features.name: Persona-based prompting for Copilot
features.description: Copilot can adopt different personas such as functional consultant, solution architect, or other roles to provide context-specific analysis and recommendations. Prompts should define persona, context, scope, and instructions for best results.
caveats: Requires user to articulate persona and context clearly

features.name: Solution design critique and alternatives with Copilot
features.description: Copilot can critique proposed solution designs, identify risks, suggest alternative approaches, and evaluate whether custom development is necessary or if standard Business Central features could achieve the requirement through alternative pathways.
caveats: User must understand Business Central to evaluate alternatives
Performance risks may be introduced by certain design choices

features.name: Code review capability in Copilot for consultants
features.description: Consultants who are reasonably proficient in reading code can use Copilot in coding tools to understand what code pieces and functions are doing, including validation checks, without necessarily being developers or writing their own code.
caveats: Requires user to be reasonably well-versed in reading and interpreting code
Only useful if consultant has coding literacy

features.name: UAT test case generation from requirements
features.description: Copilot generates functional test cases based on requirements, including preconditions, test data, testing steps, expected results, variations, and coverage mapping to link test cases back to original requirements.
caveats: Requires clear requirement documentation as input
Coverage mapping helps track test-to-requirement relationships

features.name: Negative and edge case test scenario generation
features.description: Copilot can generate test scenarios for unusual configurations and failure modes, complementing standard happy path testing to improve test coverage and catch less common problem scenarios.
caveats: Requires understanding of what edge cases are relevant to the business

features.name: Multi-role test scenario creation
features.description: Test scenarios can be generated from multiple user perspectives such as site manager, accounts payable, or project accountant to ensure different roles' workflows are covered in UAT.
caveats: Requires understanding of different user roles in the business process

features.name: Copilot documentation generation
features.description: Copilot can generate documentation including user guides, create multiple audience-specific variations, handle rewrites for different roles such as end users versus administrators, and leverage project artifacts from SharePoint and other sources based on user permissions.
caveats: Access to SharePoint artifacts depends on user permissions
Quality depends on provided prompts and source material

features.name: Copilot documentation standardization
features.description: Copilot can standardize documentation across multiple authors by applying consistent structure and style, including standardized sections like introduction, business process reference, prerequisites, steps, and expected results.
caveats: Requires clear guidance from user on desired structure

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot custom instructions
features.description: Users can store custom instructions in Microsoft 365 Copilot settings under personalization to guide content generation, such as writing style preferences, use of active voice, consistent terminology, and structure requirements.
caveats: Custom instructions can be toggled on or off per task
Requires deliberate setup by the user

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot saved memories
features.description: Copilot can save general memories about the user such as their audience, documentation approach, and default assumptions to avoid restating context in every prompt.
caveats: Saved memories can be toggled on or off
More general in nature than custom instructions

features.name: Copilot issue summarization
features.description: Copilot can quickly summarize issues and lengthy conversations by synthesizing email threads, chats, and project history to provide rapid context for consultants joining an issue resolution effort.
caveats: Requires access to relevant communication channels and documents

features.name: Copilot root cause hypothesis generation
features.description: Copilot can generate hypotheses for root causes framed in the context of Business Central, identify patterns in issue logs and telemetry, and reference recurring issues from previous projects.
caveats: Requires access to issue logs, telemetry, and project history
User must frame context appropriately for BC-specific analysis

features.name: Copilot root cause analysis documentation
features.description: Copilot can structure root cause analysis documents including issue summaries, change correlation analysis, and suggestions for corrective and preventive actions based on support tickets and system configuration history.
caveats: Requires structured access to support tickets and configuration documentation

features.name: Number series suggestions
features.description: Business Central has an inbuilt Copilot capability to suggest number series setup, reducing the time and effort required to configure number series.

features.name: Autofill field suggestions
features.description: Business Central offers autofill field suggestions to help users understand unfamiliar fields and provide example values based on context.
caveats: Helpful for field discovery but should not be the sole source of validation

features.name: Analysis assist
features.description: Business Central's analysis assist feature allows users to group and analyze data using natural language queries to identify anomalies and unexpected combinations in datasets, useful for data migration validation.
caveats: Requires users to understand what anomalies to look for

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
features.description: MCP is a standard way for AI agents to interact with Business Central APIs without requiring direct integrations. It allows AI agents to discover available data and actions, read Business Central data, and perform configured actions where permissions allow.
caveats: Setup is configurable by administrators
Limited to entities and actions exposed by MCP configuration
Requires permissions to be properly configured

features.name: Copilot Studio agents for Business Central
features.description: Copilot Studio allows building AI agents that can query Business Central data using MCP, supporting interactions for customer support, ordering, and other business processes. Agents can access live Business Central data for finance, sales, purchase, service, or project processes.
caveats: Requires MCP to be properly configured
Functional consultants should understand scope of data access required
Depends on appropriate permissions setup

features.name: Future agentic scenarios
features.description: AI agents will increasingly help execute repeatable business tasks in Business Central, and consultants may need to help define what data agents should be allowed to access.
features.status_evidence_quote: future agentic scenarios future it could be very near future the speed that these these agentic capabilities are developing at where AI helps execute
caveats: Timeline is described as potentially very near future
Scope and capabilities not yet fully defined

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium Work Edition
features.description: Subscription-based AI assistant that integrates with Microsoft 365 tools, using OpenAI models. Provides access to work resources and web content for document summarization, requirement rewriting, workflow documentation, and risk identification. Costs approximately $30 per user per month, though pricing varies by country.
caveats: Approximately $30 per user per month (varies by country)
Cost structure may shift toward token consumption limits with fair-use policies

features.name: AI-Assisted Code Review and Refactoring
features.description: AI assistance for suggesting changes to complex Business Central code, including business logic changes and refactoring for extensions beyond standard functionality. Performance has improved significantly since early 2026.
caveats: Requires developer judgment and validation
Works better on vanilla installations and well-componentized code
Personal experience with complex customizations varies
Performance uplift observed since start of 2026

features.name: AI-generated test case suggestions
features.description: Copilot capability to automatically generate test case drafts from requirements workshops. Can produce approximately 30 test points in about one minute with attention to prerequisites, data setup, and variations. Outputs are first-draft level requiring manual refinement but save 40-50% of time compared to manual creation.
caveats: Outputs are first-draft level requiring manual refinement
Saves 40-50% of time compared to manual creation
Requires human review for quality control

features.name: Copilot Studio agents for document processing
features.description: Capability to use Copilot Studio agents for automated requirements gathering and document interpretation. Agents can process files, transcripts, and audio recordings from workshops with strict instructions.
caveats: Requires proper setup and configuration
Benefits from shared organizational resources

features.name: AI-assisted documentation generation
features.description: Copilot capability to accelerate creation of documentation first drafts. Works well when generating documentation alongside test cases and requirements.
caveats: First draft quality, requires human refinement
